title: derris stuhlmannii
intro: Derris stuhlmannii, commonly known as the African soap tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly its use in traditional African medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Derris stuhlmannii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
